summary: Typed event memory with a deterministic pre-commit judgment gate (projectmem: issues/attempts/fixes/decisions/notes as typed records with worked/failed/partial outcomes in an append-only log plus distilled files; a lookup warns before a commit repeats a recorded failed approach, citing the prior failure; memory never deleted, staleness flagged for human decision; bounded summaries; plan.md intent separate from the event log; project-scoped plain files) + declarative self-improving pipelines (DSPy: typed signatures composed into modules instead of hand-written prompts; optimizers compile prompts and few-shot demos against a defined metric; compiled prompts versioned/reviewed/sealed like code; bounded optimization, never recursive self-improvement) + textual-gradient optimization as a review discipline (TextGrad: natural-language critique flows backward, rewriting each variable against a stated loss; human-written evaluation instruction, recorded critique, proposed rewrite through the same promotion gate; no unattended self-rewriting, no weight training). Patterns restated in our own words only; no code, no network/wallet/signing/payment/API-key code, no benchmark, performance, star-count, or deployment claims as fact.
